scope:
Package K1c-4 (WEB + PACK WORDS ONLY, small): no English developer text on a Polish screen of the 'Co wyslalismy' family. Branch claude/m1-w0 is at d0ea24cb or later (K1c-3b: the button 'Pokaz w grafie' works; the navigator draws the record of a request). Read docs/reports/INDEX.md section 'S1 / M1-K1c3b' ('what is left') and the section 'Czego jeszcze NIE ma' of docs/reports/M1_CHECKPOINT_1.md; nothing else.
PROBLEM (seen in screenshots by the previous agent): (1) the kernel writes the reason of every receipt item as an English sentence at SEND time (loom/src/chat/chat_engine.cpp receipt_item(...) 'why' arguments, e.g. 'the instruction of the application or of the conversation', 'the active nodes of the memory tree', 'nodes of the graph related to the question', 'what the person wrote in this turn', 'standing rules the guardian was allowed to send', 'the selection as a graph packet (flow ...)', history items by level) and the sheet under an answer (loom/web/src/components/ContextReceipt.tsx + context-receipt-state.ts) and the navigator rows (navigator-receipt.ts, derived rows, docs/reports/M1_CHECKPOINT_1/m1-sent-graph.png) show it unchanged on the Polish screen; (2) the sentence under 'Brak sladu (zapisane przed M1)' ('missing.also' in conversation_view.pack, shown with the kernel's list also_when) names the settings keys context_receipt_store and trace_context - jargon for a non-engineer; (3) look for any other raw English or raw key still visible in these screens (the sheet, the line under an answer, the navigator rows/notes/card of the record, the + > Kontekst submenu, the strip, the model sheet) by running the existing e2e scripts with Polish language and grepping the rendered texts for ASCII-English phrases or dotted keys - list what you find in the card, fix what is in the pack/web, and say what is kernel text that stays.
DECISION (mine, you may improve it and must record it with how to reverse under 'S1 / M1-K1c4' in docs/reports/INDEX.md): the stored English 'why' is DATA of the record and stays unchanged (the record is a fact written at send time; no kernel change, no receipt schema change). The screens show a plain-language word from the PACK chosen by a stable key and fall back to the kernel's sentence only when the pack has no word for the key: key = the item's ref for the fixed refs (system_prompt, guardian_rules, memory_tree, graph_memory, unified_context, knowledge_context, question, active_task, graph_reply_instruction) and the source_kind otherwise (memory_node, 'message:<level>' history levels, 'message:graph', graph_packet, ...) - take the REAL list from loom/src/chat/chat_engine.cpp and context_format.cpp, do not invent keys; each word pl + en in loom/data/profiles/conversation_view.pack next to the existing 'ref.*' words (the sheet already maps ref.system_prompt etc. for LABELS - reuse that mechanism and its naming). One shared pure function (e.g. whyWords(item, t)) used by the sheet and by the navigator rows/card; unit-tested in both languages including the fallback to the kernel text for an unknown key. For (2): rewrite 'missing.also' in plain words (e.g. 'albo zapis sladu jest wylaczony w ustawieniach') pl + en and keep the raw setting names ONLY inside the folded 'Szczegoly techniczne' block or the data-kernel-answer attribute, not in the visible sentence.
Regenerate loom/src/onboarding/builtin.inc and loom/web/src/onboarding/generated/conversation-view.json with python3 loom/src/onboarding/gen_onboarding_pack.py (explicit chunk lengths - keep that), then python3 /home/user/chatadhd/tools/clang_inc_check.py loom/build/dev must stay all ok and cmake --build --preset dev (background, polled) then ctest -R 'onboarding_pack|kb_pack|context_data|settings_fields|graph_entry|runtime_profile|kb_data_domains' green. If the words need a native rebuild only because builtin.inc changed, that is expected. Update the e2e expectations that read these texts (take every expected string from the pack via the helper m1-words.mjs, no literals; wait for conditions after a tap) in m1-context-sent-native.mjs / m1-context-menu-native.mjs; re-shoot ONLY the screenshots of docs/reports/M1_CHECKPOINT_1/ whose text changed (m1-sent-graph.png and the sheet shots that show a 'why') with M1_SHOTS_DIR in a scratch dir, and fix the report sentences that quote them (the bullet about English 'dlaczego' in 'Czego jeszcze NIE ma' must become true/false as it now is, in plain Polish). Do NOT touch kernel code, loom/android/smoke/*, the golden chat_request_legacy.json or the receipt schema. If a new route literal is added (not expected) run the registry chain. Commit in 2-3 pieces and push to origin claude/m1-w0. If after about 50 tool calls a piece is unfinished, commit what is consistent and return done=false with exactly what is left.
accept: cd loom/web && npm run build succeeds; npm run test:context-receipt, test:composer-menu, test:context-strip, test:navigator-receipt, test:testids-doc and the neighbours of what you touched pass; node e2e/m1-context-sent-native.mjs and e2e/m1-context-menu-native.mjs and e2e/m1-navigator-native.mjs pass TWICE in a row with git status clean afterwards (screenshots to a scratch M1_SHOTS_DIR except the intended report shots); python3 loom/src/onboarding/gen_onboarding_pack.py --check clean; python3 /home/user/chatadhd/tools/clang_inc_check.py loom/build/dev all ok; the ctest set above green; all screenshots referenced by the report exist; pushed to origin claude/m1-w0. The card pastes: the list of English/raw texts found in step (3) with what was done about each, the rendered why of 4 different items before and after (pl), and the new 'Brak sladu' sentence.
rules_extra: Shared machine: never kill processes by name; record the pid/port of the e2e servers you start and kill only those. Do NOT run the full gate (S1 does). CACHE RULE: no single tool call longer than ~4 minutes - run builds, tests and e2e in the background and poll with short calls. One native build at a time (loom/build/dev of this worktree). Keep context small: grep and line ranges, never dump big files. Tests must not depend on speed or order (wait for conditions; no sleeps that race). Private data: synthetic data only; never read docs/exports or eval/real-holdout-key. Texts for the owner in plain Polish and English; nothing described as working that is only planned.
